_read_me: The script, one beat per section. `say` is what the voice reads (Hinglish in Devanagari for hi-IN prosody; English tech words in Latin). `on_screen` is the copy the design is built from. `caption` is what the .srt shows. `script_target` may be null: then the VO is measured and the picture is cut to it.
